title: FLA import: text-field instance colorEffect not forwarded to TextDisplayObject
description: In flash8-import.ts text element branch (~line 739), the colorEffect read by readCPicSymbolBaseFields is not passed to TextDisplayObject. Instance-level tint/brightness/advanced color effects on text fields are silently lost on FLA import. Fix: call toColorEffect(el.colorEffect) and set colorEffect on the TextDisplayObject.
